name: Health Insurance Summit ICS Calendar
prompt:
There is a Markdown file on the desktop: root/Desktop/health_insurance_summit_schedule/summit_agenda_2024.md, which contains the summit schedule divided into different venues. You need to parse the agendas of all venues in this file and merge them into one .ics calendar file, saved to root/Desktop/health_insurance_summit_schedule/summit_calendar_merged.ics.

Note: if multiple sub-forums have agendas in the same time slot, retain all of them; do not omit or overwrite any session because of time overlap.

The title format of each calendar event should be uniformly written as: [venue abbreviation]-agenda topic, for example [TPA网络]-外部医疗资源对接研讨. In addition, state in the event's location or notes field which sub-forum it belongs to.

All events must be set with a reminder 15 minutes in advance.
